items.title: Counted phase work

source.anchor: Algorithm3.1, AlgorithmD.2 and D.4 final paragraph: two query arrays,2J proximal and2J direct gradient calls; component restatement with explicit finite-array/incoming-state boundary
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; bounded ASTIS exact-real implementation component.

items.statement: Under mu=nu product ((Gaussian product Gaussian) product (Gaussian Fin-m array product Gaussian Fin-m array)), set d=finrank(E), a=exp(-h/2), sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)), MR=M+(1-exp(-h))*d, B=6MR+3eps^2+3eta*d, C=2+(1+log((1-c)^(-1)))/(-log c), L0=C[1+log(1+sqrt(2MR)/eps)], L1=C[1+log(1+sqrt(4MR+2S^2B)/eps)]. There exist measurable p,q,N with exact proximal equation, ||q(y)-p(y)||<=eps and successful proximalQuery from y with fuel N(y)+1 returning (q(y),N(y)+1) for every y. P0=aP+sigma zeta0, Y0_i=X+t_i P0, Z0_j=grad V(q(Y0_j)+sqrt(eta)G0_j), Y1_i=Y0_i-sum_j omega_ij Z0_j, Z1_j=grad V(q(Y1_j)+sqrt(eta)G1_j), Phi=(X+hP0-sum_j positionWeight_j Z1_j, a(P0-sum_j momentumWeight_j Z1_j)+sigma zeta1). The same Phi is measurable and defines the Gaussian pushforward Markov kernel. The count T=2*m+sum_i[(N(Y0_i)+1)+(N(Y1_i)+1)] is measurable. For every driving input w, phaseQuery with fuel(y)=N(y)+1 returns exactly some(Phi(w),T(w)); the real cast of T is integrable under mu and E_mu T<=m*(2+L0+L1).
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel sigma-algebra; the actual array index is Fin m for supplied natural m, not silently the source J.
V is C2, kappa>=1, and kappa^(-1)||v||^2 <= D2V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2 for all x,v. Its actual gradient vanishes at the supplied xstar.
0<eta<=c<1, eps>0, h>=0, M>=0, S>=0. The incoming probability law nu on (X,P) has integrable ||X-xstar||^2+||P||^2, with integral at most M.

The supplied deterministic nodes satisfy |t_i|<=1 and each supplied omega row satisfies sum_j |omega_ij|<=S. Position and momentum weights are arbitrary supplied real arrays; source Chebyshev quadrature is not instantiated.

obligations.label: Source quadrature/global D7/D8 and main results remain open

bindings.boundary: Single full Gaussian phase with supplied incoming integrable state L2 budget, finite bounded nodes and row l1 bounds; actual successful exact-real interpreter output and total gradient count. Sufficient finite fuel certifies execution and is not a runtime precomputation or a count/cost hypothesis. No cost claim for failed insufficient-fuel executions. Gaussian sampling and arithmetic are not gradient queries. Source quadrature/J adapter, run-wide D7 induction, D8 parameter/iteration substitution, Wp, proxy-warmness, initialization, PBPS and composition/main results remain open. No TV-to-unbounded-cost transfer.
